journey.loginDescription: Enter your credentials to continue to this portal.
journey.invitationDescription: Choose a password to activate your access to this portal.
journey.recoveryDescription: Request a secure link to reset your password.
journey.resetDescription: Choose a new password, then sign in again.
journey.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
journey.occupied: You already have a session in this portal. Continue with it, or sign out before using different credentials.
journey.localAndRemoteSignOut: You have signed out of this portal.
journey.localOnlySignOut: You have signed out on this device. We could not confirm sign-out on the server. Your other portal is unchanged.
journey.unavailable: We could not confirm access right now. Please try again.
journey.invalidCredentials: We could not sign you in. Check your credentials and try again.
journey.notCompleted: We could not complete this request. Check your link and details before trying again.
journey.checkFields: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
journey.invalidLinkOrFields: Check your password and invitation or reset link. Request a new link if needed.
journey.recoverySent: If the details match an account, a reset link will be sent. You can safely close this page.
journey.resetComplete: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
journey.changePasswordDescription: Set a new password before continuing in this portal.
account.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
account.uncertainChange: We could not confirm the change. Review the refreshed account details before trying again.
account.emailConfirmation: Change your sign-in email address? Your other portal account is unchanged.
account.emailChanged: Your email address has been changed.
account.signOutDescription: These actions affect {{audience}} only. Your other portal is unchanged.
account.signOutAllConfirmation: Sign out of every session in {{audience}}, including this one?
account.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue.
account.revokeDescription: Access from this session will end. If this is your current session, you will need to sign in again.
